experiment: Omit per-entry source label copies for ordinary Loki queries; retain original labels for distinct and tail frames.
retention_decision: First exact-image control: total peak RSS lower in all three pairs with disjoint ranges; logs-role CPU lower in all three, whole-stack CPU mixed and query p99 mixed. Await confirmation before a retention decision. Both experimental images include the same subsequently reverted metric-WAL move; current branch requires final source qualification.

diagnostic_selection.limitations: Summarized allocation counts include startup and seed; no performance ratio inferred.

original_production_golden.scope: Complete folded/categorized query, distinct after source-label rewriting, backfill/live tail frames and unchanged input records. Original folded encoding retains empty buckets after distinct.

scope: Matched all-role release image and workload with unchanged API, label categorization, publication pacing, budgets and tenant filtering. Instrumented captures remain diagnostics. A same-VM revision control is needed before retention. All seven rebuilt application binaries differ from the baseline; runtime configuration, base layer and nonbinary filesystem content are verified unchanged. The paired Loki sources contain the same subsequently rejected metric WAL implementation. Final retained-source qualification must reflect its removal.

verified_candidate_allocation_capture.interpretation: Diagnostic only: startup, seed, heaptrack overhead and unequal completed query counts (169 candidate versus 133 baseline) prevent a normalized performance claim.
